title: Odds-Shift Slippage in One-vs-Rest Rankers: Diagnosing and Repairing Reweighting-Induced Top-K Errors
abstract: arXiv:2609.13810v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: One-vs-rest rankers that show each user the top-$K$ of many rare labels usually counter imbalance with a per-label positive-class weight, scale_pos_weight $= n_-/n_+$. Elkan's identity says such a weight shifts label $j$'s log-odds by $\ln w_j$, so the model ranks by weighted odds rather than by the marginal that is Bayes-optimal for precision@$K$, and suggests inverting the shift afterwards; what a finite learner does with a weight in the thousands, and which repair then works, has not been measured. We call the gap between the promised and the realized shift odds-shift slippage and measure it on matched pairs of LightGBM and MLP models that differ only in the weights. On Santander the weight takes MAP@7 from 0.808 to 0.117; for the boosted pairs the ideal odds shift accounts for 23% of that loss (32% on Instacart; 98% for an MLP pair on the same rows) and slippage for the rest. translated_title: One-vs-Rest排序器中的几率偏移滑移：诊断与修复重加权导致的Top-K错误
translated_abstract: 向每个用户展示众多稀有标签top-$K$结果的one-vs-rest排序器，通常使用每个标签的正类权重（scale_pos_weight $= n_-/n_+$）来对抗类别不平衡。Elkan恒等式指出，这样的权重会将标签$j$的对数几率平移$\ln w_j$，因此模型实际上是按加权几率而非按对precision@$K$贝叶斯最优的边际概率进行排序，并提示可以事后反转这一平移；然而，有限样本的学习器在权重高达数千时的真实表现如何，以及哪种修复方法有效，此前从未被测量。我们将承诺的偏移与实际实现的偏移之间的差距称为几率偏移滑移，并在除权重外完全匹配的LightGBM与MLM模型对上对其进行了测量。在Santander数据集上，该权重使MAP@7从0.808骤降至0.117；对于梯度提升模型对，理想的几率偏移仅解释了该损失的23%（Instacart上为32%；在相同数据行上MLP模型对为98%），其余损失均来自滑移。我们证明了叶节点步长被限制在……的梯度提升器（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次定义并测量了one-vs-rest排序器中类别重加权所承诺的对数几率偏移与实际实现的偏移之间的“几率偏移滑移”现象，证明滑移（而非理想偏移）才是重加权严重损害Top-K排序精度（如Santander上MAP@7从0.808跌至0.117）的主因，并提出相应的诊断与修复方法。
en_tdlr: This paper defines and measures "odds-shift slippage"—the gap between the log-odds shift promised by class reweighting and what finite learners actually realize—showing that slippage, not the ideal shift, is the dominant cause of reweighting-induced Top-K errors in one-vs-rest rankers (e.g., MAP@7 dropping from 0.808 to 0.117 on Santander), and proposes diagnoses and repairs.
